info.bio: Mark–Almond were an English band of the late 1960s and early 1970s, who worked in the territory between rock and jazz. In 1970 Jon Mark and Johnny Almond formed Mark-Almond (also occasionally referred to as The Mark-Almond Band). The melancholy tones of saxophonist Almond were an integral part of the group's sound, and Almond frequently played flutes as well, including the rarely-heard bass flute. Characterized by a blend of blues and jazz riffs

scenes.name: Rock progresivo
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Al emigrar a Gran Bretaña, el rock se convierte en mercancía de moda pero también se descontextualiza: lo que en EE UU era el diario de la juventud se vuelve en Gran Bretaña un ensayo. El progresivo no comenta la cultura juvenil sino que busca la innovación técnica: arranca con las óperas rock (S.F. Sorrow, Tommy) y los álbumes conceptuales, lo cimentan Traffic, Jeff Beck, Jethro Tull, Family y Genesis, y alcanza su cima con King Crimson (In The Court Of The Crimson King), Van Der Graaf Generator y Yes. Colosseum, la Third Ear Band (inventores de la world music), las variantes góticas (High Tide, Black Widow) y folk (Comus, Strawbs), Gentle Giant, Emerson Lake & Palmer y Roxy Music, que revoluciona el género y prepara la new wave y el synth-pop.
